summary: Dave & Buster's filed an 8-K disclosing the board's August 11, 2026 appointment of Amanda Busby, 53, as Chief Operations Officer, succeeding no named predecessor in the excerpt. Terms include a $450,000 base salary, a 70% target bonus, 72,464 RSUs vesting over three annual installments, a 74,294-share option at $8.97, and up to 55,741 PSUs tied to same-store sales. This is a routine officer appointment rather than a forced departure, so no deal mechanics, premium, or regulatory clock apply; watch for operational execution and any further Item 5.02 departures.
